observations.body: The signed-out root page displays the BugBusters HR employee portal sign-in form with Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and a Demo accounts section listing emily.dawson as Employee.
The Employee username and configured password have been entered and Sign in is ready to submit.
Sign in authenticated the Employee and displayed the dashboard shell with navigation and an Emily Dawson header.
Timesheet displays a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
The empty Monday entry is set to 8 hours as evaluation data; the displayed total is 8 h and Save draft is ready to submit.
Save draft preserved the evaluation-data Monday value of 8 and displayed “Draft saved.” beside total 8 h.
The saved 8-hour evaluation-data week remains in draft state and Submit week is ready.
Submit week changed the marked evaluation-data week to submitted, displayed “Timesheet submitted.”, and disabled all hour inputs plus Save draft and Submit week.
